evals.prompt: Scaffold a new skill called "http-retry-policy" under skills/http-retry-policy/, following this repository's conventions. Create a real SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name, description, version) and a real evals/evals.json with skill_name and at least one eval. Write the files to disk.
evals.expected_output: Real files created at skills/http-retry-policy/SKILL.md and skills/http-retry-policy/evals/evals.json, with frontmatter/schema fields present — graded against the actual workspace, not the chat response.

assertions.text: SKILL.md exists at the expected path
evals.json exists at the expected path

evals.prompt: Add an eval case to an evals/evals.json file for a skill that reviews Go database code, verifying the reviewed skill flags SQL built via fmt.Sprintf/string concatenation as unsafe. Show the full JSON eval object (id, prompt, expected_output, assertions).
evals.expected_output: A schema-conformant eval object with id/prompt/expected_output/assertions, using deterministic contains/matches checks rather than reaching for an LLM judge for a mechanically-checkable assertion.

assertions.text: Uses a deterministic check rather than an LLM judge for this mechanically-checkable assertion
